Name: Dragon Pepper
Author: HellaGayJaime
Description:
[color=#cc0000][size=4][b]Warning: This fruit [u]will damage you[/u] if you're not careful![/b][/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod is for all the spice heads! It adds [b]Dragon Pepper[/b], a universe-friendly cultivar of [i]Capsicum Chinense[/i] with a typical bonnet-like shape and squat, pointy tail. Like all super-spicy peppers, this plant can technically grow in temperate climates, but it really thrives in hot, sunny climates.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This crop is intended to be a late-game money maker to mix it up when you're bored of Ancient Fruit. You can get started by exchanging one [b]Dragon Tooth[/b] for [b]Dragon Pepper Seeds[/b] from the Island Trader (infinite store stock). For commercial-scale propagation, using the Seed Maker is recommended. It takes [b]18 days[/b] to grow, with a 4 day regrow period. Harvests will yield 1-3 peppers per plant with a small chance for extra harvest. Dragon Peppers have a base sell price of 200g.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Putting Dragon pepper in a keg will produce [b]Uncomfortably Hot Sauce[/b] in the same time it takes to brew Pale Ale. This sauce is an Artisan Good with a base price of 550g. Drinking it will give you 2 Speed, but drinking a whole bottle of this sauce is a risky move... [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you give a bottle of this sauce to Gus, he will tell you the recipe for [b]Rumpled Fruit Skin[/b], from the Desert Festival. It takes 1 Sauce, 1 Starfruit, 1 Wheat Flour and 1 Oil. It gives 3 Luck and 1 Speed, but [u]does not stack with other food buffs[/u] the same way the Desert Festival version does. [/color][color=#cc0000][i](Note: When you gift Gus the sauce, there won't be a tooltip/pop-up showing you got the recipe. But it will be available in your kitchen.)[/i][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Gifting Dragon Pepper and Uncomfortably Hot Sauce has mostly the same effect on vanilla NPCs as Hot Pepper, with a few exceptions:[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Those who dislike Hot Pepper HATE Dragon Pepper.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Demetrius loves Dragon Pepper because it is scientifically remarkable.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Gus likes Uncomfortably Hot Sauce.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Shane, Lewis, and Demetrius have unique dialogue when gifted the pepper. The portraits in the banner are just for fun, and not modded into this dialogue (sorry!)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Rumpled Fruit Skin does not have gift tastes or dialogue changes. It will have the same gift effect as any non-specific Cooking item.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#cc0000][size=3][b]It is recommended that you harvest dragon peppers by hand, where you can be more precise and delicate. Industrial harvesting methods can rupture pepper cells, causing capsaicin to splash out and burn the farmer in their sensitive skin and mucus membranes. Eating whole raw peppers is not recommended, nor is drinking whole bottles of sauce made with this pepper! For safety, use a small amount when cooking.[/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip in your \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
Do the same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you haven't already. You need these for most Stardew mods.
Do the same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url][/color] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore.[/url]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Selph and SpaceChase0 for their framework mods which make the player damage effects work.[/color][/size]
